cohort: Pregnant women with glucose challenge test results below 130 mg/dl and between 130-139 mg/dl.
finding: A glucose challenge test result between 130-139 mg/dl was not associated with higher maternal and neonatal morbidity compared to results below 130 mg/dl.
mod_finding: Increased cesarean section rates were reported in the group with GCT results between 130-139 mg/dl.
